meta.title: CAD Champions: free CAD test and competition training in Qatar
meta.description: Take a free 90-minute CAD test, get an instant skill report, and train for the national Mechanical Engineering CAD skills competition with a studio in Lusail.
meta.ogAlt: CAD Champions: train for the national CAD skills competition

jsonLd.courseName: CAD Champions: Mechanical Engineering CAD training
jsonLd.courseDescription: A free diagnostic CAD test with an automatic skill report, followed by online training in Autodesk Inventor, Fusion or SOLIDWORKS and in-person sessions in Lusail, Qatar.
jsonLd.orgDescription: Digital fabrication studio in Lusail, Qatar.

hero.title: Train for the national CAD skills competition
hero.sub: Free CAD test, instant skill report, and a training path made for you.
hero.note: About 90 minutes · Inventor, Fusion or SOLIDWORKS · English and Arabic
hero.visualLabel: A pair of meshing gears on a shaft, drawn like a CAD model

trust.by: By Gestaltung360, a digital fabrication studio in Lusail

how.title: Five steps from sign-up to training
how.intro: Each step unlocks the next. Your dashboard always shows the one thing to do now.

account.title: Create a free account
account.text: Sign up with your email in about two minutes.

ready.title: Get ready
ready.text: Set up your software and try a practice upload, so test day has no surprises.

test.title: Take the free test
test.text: About 90 minutes of real competition-style tasks on your own computer.

report.title: Get your skill report
report.text: See your score in each skill area and what to work on first.

train.title: Train and qualify
train.text: Follow your training path and earn a place in the in-person sessions.

need.title: What you need
need.intro: Check these five things before you take the test.

items.computer: A Windows computer for Autodesk Inventor, or a Mac with Autodesk Fusion.
items.software: CAD software that can save <term>STEP files</term>: Inventor, Fusion or SOLIDWORKS. Some offer free student licences, and the Get Ready page shows how.
items.mouse: A mouse. A touchpad makes CAD work much slower.
items.internet: An internet connection to upload your files.

need.tracksIntro: You choose your track when you sign up, and you can change it later.

inventor.name: Autodesk Inventor
inventor.text: The software the competition is built on. Needs a Windows computer.

fusion.name: Autodesk Fusion
fusion.text: Our second track. A good choice for Mac users and schools that use Fusion.

solidworks.name: SOLIDWORKS
solidworks.text: Already use SOLIDWORKS? You are welcome on our third track.

need.solidworksNote: The competition uses Autodesk Inventor or Fusion. The SOLIDWORKS track builds the same skills, and we recommend switching to Inventor before competition mocks.
need.help: No computer or software yet? Contact us, we can help.
need.whatsappText: Hi, I'd like to join CAD Champions but I don't have a computer or CAD software yet.

skills.title: Six skill areas, weighted like the real marking
skills.intro: Every task in the test and the training is tagged with one of these areas, so your report shows exactly where you are strong.
skills.about: These areas and weights follow the published Technical Description for Mechanical Engineering CAD, the skill that WorldSkills competitions use. We describe it here so you know what to expect.
skills.disclaimer: CAD Champions is an independent training program by Gestaltung360 and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WorldSkills International.

modules.title: Four modules on four days
modules.intro: The competition project is split into four separate modules. Each one has its own fixed time, and you hand in your files at the end of each day.
modules.total: {hours} hours of competition time in total
modules.projection: Drawings are given in <term>first-angle projection</term>. You should know both first and third angle, and you may answer in either.
modules.alsoTested: Also tested across the modules: 3D printing, 3D scanning, <term>model-based definition</term>, limits and fits, surface texture and GD&T.

grading.title: Clear, checkable marking
grading.body: 3D models are checked automatically by measuring their volume and <term>mass properties</term> against the correct answer. Drawings get an automatic checklist review, then a trainer confirms them. You get feedback on every task.
grading.judgement: A few items, such as how clear a drawing is, are judged by a trainer on a 0 to 3 scale, the way competition judges mark them.
grading.flowLabel: How a model becomes a score

measure.title: Measurements
measure.text: Volume, area and mass properties are compared with the answer.

score.title: Your score
score.text: Each check adds marks to its skill area.

ladder.title: Six levels of 3D modelling
ladder.caption: Start at the level your test shows, and climb one step at a time. After the ladder come the four competition modules and full-length mock competitions.

l1.title: Simple extrude
l1.text: Sketch a shape and give it thickness.

l2.title: Holes and fillets
l2.text: Add holes, pockets, fillets and chamfers.

l3.title: Revolve and sweep
l3.text: Revolve, sweep, loft, shell and patterns.

l4.title: Parameters
l4.text: Drive parts with dimensions and build part families.

l5.title: Assemblies
l5.text: Join parts with constraints and sub-assemblies.

l6.title: Full timed project
l6.text: Model, assemble and draw a project against the clock.

studio.title: Learn from a working fabrication studio
studio.intro: You train with the people who design and make real parts every day, in a studio full of the machines you model for.

inPerson.title: Hands-on training in Lusail

what.measure: Measure real parts with the allowed instruments.
what.scan: 3D scan parts and compare them with your models.
what.mock: Sit full-length, timed mock competitions under real rules.

inPerson.who: The top students from the online qualifier.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Can't find your answer? Message us and we'll help.

free.a: Yes. Your account, the Get Ready steps, the diagnostic test and your skill report cost nothing. You only pay if you decide to join the training.

software.q: Which CAD software can I use?
software.a: Any CAD software that can export STEP files (AP214 or AP242) in millimetres. Our training has three tracks: Autodesk Inventor (recommended for the competition), Autodesk Fusion and SOLIDWORKS.

competitionSoftware.q: Which software does the competition use?
competitionSoftware.a: The competition is built on Autodesk Inventor, and some editions also allow Autodesk Fusion. Competitors must use the software provided on the day. That is why Inventor is our recommended track. SOLIDWORKS users are welcome: the SOLIDWORKS track builds the same skills, and we recommend switching to Inventor before competition mocks.

mac.a: Use Autodesk Fusion, which runs on Mac. It is our second track and it saves STEP files for the test. Inventor needs Windows, so if you aim for the competition, plan to practise on a Windows computer later.

noSoftware.q: I don't have CAD software yet
noSoftware.a: Autodesk offers free education licences for Inventor and Fusion to eligible students. Checking your student status can take a few days, so start early. The Get Ready page walks you through it. No computer either? Message us and we'll help.

duration.q: How long is the test and can I pause it?
duration.a: About 90 minutes. The timer runs on our server and cannot be paused, even if you close the page, so start when you have quiet time. Files that finish uploading within 60 seconds after time ends are still accepted.

files.a: 3D models as STEP files (.step or .stp), one per task, and drawings as PDF files. Each task says exactly what it needs, and the Get Ready page lets you practise an upload first.

results.q: How fast do I get results?
results.a: 3D models are checked automatically, so you see a first score as soon as you submit. A trainer then confirms your drawings, and we email you when your full report is ready.

official.a: No. CAD Champions is independent training that prepares you for the Mechanical Engineering CAD competition. It does not run the competition or select national teams. CAD Champions is an independent training program by Gestaltung360 and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WorldSkills International.

eligibility.a: Training is open to everyone. The world competition is for competitors aged 22 or younger in the competition year. Check your local selection rules. [TODO-MO: confirm the local Qatar rule]

price.a: You'll see prices after your test, with the training plan that fits your results. The test and your report stay free either way.

payment.a: By Fawran bank transfer. You send the transfer from your bank app and upload a screenshot of it. We check it and confirm your place.

privacy.a: Your files and results are visible only to you and our trainers. We use them to grade your work and plan your training. The privacy policy explains the details.

under18.a: Yes, with a parent's or guardian's consent. When you sign up we ask for their name and phone number and their consent.

final.title: Ready to see where you stand?
final.text: Take the free test, get your skill report and start the training that fits you.
